title: GuidedVote evaluation index (one line per run)
paper: When does a small guide model help a smaller solver? An empirical study of SLM-to-SLM guided reasoning
description: Run-level metadata and paired statistics for every evaluation log and SPGFT corpus in the submission_logs archive. The per-question logs themselves are available from the corresponding author.

field_definitions.file: Path of the per-question log inside the submission_logs archive.
field_definitions.seed: Seed that fixes which benchmark questions are sampled; solver vote sampling is not seeded.
field_definitions.acc_reference / acc_treatment: Accuracy (%) of the reference and treatment conditions on the same questions.
field_definitions.delta_pp: Treatment minus reference accuracy, percentage points; equals (B - C) / n_paired.
field_definitions.B_treatment_only_correct / C_reference_o: Discordant pairs used by McNemar's test.
field_definitions.mcnemar_p_yates: Two-sided McNemar test with Yates continuity correction (uncorrected for multiple comparisons).
field_definitions.status: used_in_paper, supplementary, superseded (replaced by a later run) or unusable.
field_definitions.paper_tables: Tables of the revised manuscript that use the record.
